# Runtime model dependencies

Gradle Tooling API 8.13 (Gradle contributors), AGP builder-model 8.12.2 (Android Open Source Project), Gson 2.10 (Google) and Kotlin stdlib 2.0.21 (JetBrains/Kotlin contributors) use Apache-2.0. SLF4J API 1.7.36 (QOS.ch contributors) uses MIT. These published standalone artifacts are used for model extraction, not taken from an installed IDE. Exact source URLs, checksums and package impact are in tools/agp-model/README.md and server-programs/components.

SLF4J license source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qos-ch/slf4j/v_1.7.36/LICENSE.txt
